subject.title: Unified env var management: .env should be the single source of truth

question: Should managed Gateway restart treat state-dir `.env` as authoritative over existing generated `service-env` values, or keep generated service env as the installed process environment and add conflict diagnostics/doctor guidance instead?
rationale: The remaining choice changes credential-source precedence and user-visible restart behavior, so automation should not pick the security/product contract from source inspection alone.

options.title: Warn and repair explicitly
options.body: Keep the current installed service-env precedence, but add diagnostics/docs/doctor guidance that detects conflicts and tells users how to restage from `.env`.

options.title: Make `.env` authoritative on restart
options.body: Rebuild managed service env from state-dir `.env` during restart, accepting the upgrade and credential-precedence change with focused migration proof.

options.title: Document current behavior only
options.body: Clarify the precedence chain without changing runtime behavior, leaving users to run force install or doctor when they intentionally rotate `.env` secrets.

recommendation.title: Warn and repair explicitly
recommendation.body: Keep the current installed service-env precedence, but add diagnostics/docs/doctor guidance that detects conflicts and tells users how to restage from `.env`.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history on service-env planning and the adjacent merged credential-retention decision.
